{{Short description|German biochemist (born 1960)}}
'''Marina V. Rodnina''' (born 19 November 1960) is a German biochemist.<ref name=":2" />

== Life ==
Born in [[Kiev]], Rodnina studied biology at the [[University of Kiev]] and obtained her PhD in molecular biology and genetics in 1989.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=https://www.mpg.de/408034/biophysikalische_chemie_wissM97|title=Rodnina, Marina M.V.|website=www.mpg.de|language=en|access-date=28 December 2018}}</ref> From 1990 to 1992, she was a research fellow of the Alexander von Humboldt Foundation at the [[Witten/Herdecke University]].<ref name=":0" /> Afterwards, she was a research assistant at the same university and she received her habilitation in 1997.<ref name=":0" /> From 1998 to 2008, she was a professor at the [[Witten/Herdecke University]].<ref name=":0" /> Since 2008, she is a scientific member and the director of the [[Max Planck Institute for Biophysical Chemistry]].<ref name=":0" />

== Research ==
{{Scholia}}
Rodnina's research focuses on protein synthesis by and function on the ribosome.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web|url=https://www.leopoldina.org/de/mitglieder/mitgliederverzeichnis/member/1297/|title=Mitgliederverzeichnis|website=www.leopoldina.org|language=de|access-date=28 December 2018}}</ref> In collaboration with colleagues, she was the first to visualize the activity of a ribosome with the help of a 3D cryo-electron microscope.<ref name=":1" />

== Awards ==
Rodnina is a member of the [[Göttingen Academy of Sciences and Humanities]] and the [[Academy of Sciences Leopoldina]].<ref name=":2">{{Cite web|url=https://adw-goe.de/mitglieder/personendetails/person/-c380b85327/|title=Prof. Dr. Marina Rodnina: Akademie der Wissenschaften zu Göttingen (AdW)|website=adw-goe.de|access-date=28 December 2018}}</ref><ref name=":1" /> She was awarded the [[Hans Neurath Award]] in 2015,<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.proteinsociety.org/page/protein-society-awards|title=The Protein Society : Protein Society Awards|website=www.proteinsociety.org|access-date=28 December 2018|archive-date=3 December 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191203162612/https://www.proteinsociety.org/page/protein-society-awards|url-status=dead}}</ref> the [[Gottfried Wilhelm Leibniz Prize]] in 2016,<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.dfg.de/service/presse/pressemitteilungen/2015/pressemitteilung_nr_58/index.html|title=DFG – Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft – Leibniz-Preise 2016: DFG zeichnet drei Wissenschaftlerinnen und sieben Wissenschaftler aus|website=www.dfg.de|access-date=28 December 2018|archive-date=8 September 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190908150232/https://www.dfg.de/service/presse/pressemitteilungen/2015/pressemitteilung_nr_58/index.html|url-status=dead}}</ref> and the [[Otto Warburg Medal]] in 2019.<ref> {{cite web|url=https://otto-warburg-medal.org/press-details/otto-warburg-medal-2019-for-prof-dr-marina-rodnina.html|title=Otto Warburg Medal 2019 for Prof. Dr. Marina Rodnina|publisher=GBM|accessdate= 4 April 2020}} </ref>
